[[File:AngryLittleGreenMan-TPoC.jpg|thumb|right|A Seikoshan wielding a stranglestick]]
A '''stranglestick''' was a weapon used by the [[Seikoshan]]s. They were spear length rods with a forked end with a strip of [[Leather/Legends|leather]] threaded through the forks. Targets could be restrained by tightening the strap.
